extra.summary: PA-CF boxed hoop (22 x 10 mm legs, 2 mm walls) from the plate top edge to F1/F4 closes a plate-F1-F4 triangle; plate shrinks to a 153 x 65 doubler.
extra.mass_delta_note: same proxy basis as REF 565.6 g
assumptions: F1 (-150,-62) and F4 (-178,14) are ASSUMED seat centres (clasp_sites.json not in the project)
stage+arm 3.0 kg at 80 mm; E 5 GPa; fill 0.55 for a boxed 2 mm wall section; A_top derived from the N_top = W model
REF proxy armour is ~50 g heavier than spec (161.6 vs 110.6 g); crown/keel reused unchanged
contract_changes: plate outline 158 x 100 -> 153 x 65: wing tongue seat truncated from z -76..-150 to z -76..-112 (wing lap/bolts must move up 38 mm; re-run scapular_frame)
spaulder rear feet (2 x M3 x 10 vertical into the plate top edge) kept as the hoop's roof screws, plus a U-clip capture
hoop becomes load-bearing on clasp seats F1/F4: seat M4 x 12 now carry structural load, pad/boss and insert pull-out need a re-check
decision_conflicts: Top pad is the binding harness gate (14.28 vs 14.7 kPa, 2.9 % margin): 1 N of extra seat compression = +0.25 kPa, so the headroom is only ~1.7 N (1.2 % of My). The hoop can carry the load only as tension/lift or a tiny compressive share; it is not a general load path into F1/F4.
Nothing rigid on moving skin: respected (seats and top only; static gap away from seats 11.0 mm, near seats 9.5 mm)
Flush request (2026-10-30): hoop top sits ~21 mm over skin (11 gap + 10 section), about 8 mm higher than the 1.8 mm REF spaulder

calcs.name: Reaction moment at plate
calcs.inputs: S2 cap 8.3 N.m; m_stage+arm 3.0 kg (assumed); l 0.080 m

calcs.name: REF top bolt pair
calcs.result: 410 N total on the top pair (all through the wing tongue)

calcs.name: Leg bending, vertical 50 N at the seat end
calcs.formula: sigma = F L (h/2)/I ; delta = F L^3/(3 E I)
calcs.inputs: F 50 N, L 67 mm, E 5000 MPa (annealed PA-CF XY, assumed)
calcs.result: sigma 11.2 MPa (PA-CF ~80 MPa XY, interlayer lower -> SF ~7.2 in-plane), delta 0.68 mm

calcs.name: Leg axial stiffness
calcs.result: 13379 N/mm: far stiffer than the soft-tissue seat (tens of N/mm), so the seat/clasp compliance sets the share

calcs.name: Top-pad headroom
calcs.inputs: W 56.8 N, p 14.4 kPa -> A_top 3944 mm2 (derived)
calcs.result: A_top 3944 mm2; dF 1.7 N extra compression allowed (0.25 kPa per N)

calcs.name: Load shared to the seats
calcs.result: compression share <= 1.2 % of My before the top-pad gate fails; tension (lift) share is limited by the strap preload, not computed

extra.printability: hoop ~119 x 130 x 52 mm fits the 256 cube; print flat (z up) so leg bending stress lies in the layer plane; supports under the clip slot and the sloped underside (est. 10-15 cm2, not computed); 4 perimeters, 55 % effective fill
pros: Triangulates the plate: lower tongue/wing bending demand in the sagittal plane (wing share not quantified)
Plate 278.8 g -> doubler; one structural PA-CF member replaces the shell spaulder
Gravity moment tends to put the legs in tension, which unloads the top pad slightly
cons: Can't take compressive load without breaking the 14.7 kPa top-pad gate
Higher profile than the flush REF spaulder
Truncated tongue forces a wing change
Open frame leaves the shoulder top uncovered unless a skin is added
risks: Clasp seat bosses/inserts not rated for structural loads
PA-CF interlayer strength and creep unmeasured
Hoop stiffness could act as a hard point on trapezius under strap tension
Neck lateral-flexion clearance only a static distance, not swept
gates_to_rerun: verify_armor (skin 10 mm, ROM abduction/scaption/neck lateral flexion 50 deg)
